deviation_audit.claim: at_1115 fails on main's check_saxpy on Lavapipe; root cause is a CPU-oracle bug (not Mesa FP drift as spec assumed); fix touches only check_saxpy/correctness_match; within_ulp_f32 and rewrite_verify.rs untouched; passes 5+ consecutive on Lavapipe; NVIDIA stays at frozen 4 ULP
deviation_audit.assessment: REPRODUCED AND CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY. Checked out main into a scratch git worktree: at_1115 fails deterministically on Lavapipe with 'reason: 9/1024 elements exceeded 4 ULP tolerance' (5/5 runs). On the M3.17 branch, at_1115 passes 5/5 consecutive runs on Lavapipe. git diff confirms crates/axc-driver/src/mcp/tools/rewrite_verify.rs has ZERO diff (untouched), and within_ulp_f32's function body (bench_variant.rs:579-589) has zero diff hunk touching it - only its call sites gained a per-call ulp_tolerance parameter. Ran the NVIDIA leg directly (RTX PRO 6000): at_1115 STILL FAILS on NVIDIA on this branch, with the failure reason explicitly showing 'device="NVIDIA...", max observed ULP=5863519' at the frozen 4-ULP bound - proving ulp_tolerance_for_device is NOT widened for NVIDIA. Reproduced the SAME NVIDIA failure on unmodified main (also 3/1024 fails) - confirms this is genuinely pre-existing and not introduced/worsened by M3.17. Verified ROADMAP.md:408 does carry the 'M3.16 W1/W2 ... within_ulp_f32 sign-boundary false-mismatch' backlog entry the coder cited as the real cause, corroborating the deviation's honesty.
deviation_audit.verdict: PASS (deviation is honestly disclosed and independently verified true)
